source: GPT Web full-queue sweep of 160 DCE-backed candidates

results.title: Ireland – Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
results.why: EUR 350k hosted Website and App Accessibility Audit Platform is a strong SPM-fit open procedure. DCE resolves the true deadline to 18 September 2026 at noon, but extracted selection evidence does not expose exact financial/reference thresholds, so missing gates cannot be treated as PASS.

results.title: Website and App Accessibility Audit Solution
results.why: National eTenders lane of the same EUR 350k Accessibility Audit Platform. Authoritative DCE deadline is 18 September 2026 at noon. Same unresolved mandatory selection gates as the TED lane.

results.title: Belgium – Développement d’un outil de prévision et de notification de risques de crues soudaines
unknowns: Whether SPM/partner can evidence qualifying EUR 100k comparable missions
results.why: Direct software scope for SPW, but DCE requires recent qualifying references with a minimum level of EUR 100k excl. VAT per mission and integration with WISKI REST, GESTIA IAM/OIDC-OAuth and SPW infrastructure. Partnerable, not lean-direct on present bidder evidence.

results.title: Ireland – 9191 INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS PLATFORM
results.why: EUR 850k enterprise platform is a real software opportunity, but it is a PQQ with audited accounts/turnover history and only up to five pre-qualified applicants proceeding to tender. Better as consortium/product-vendor route.

results.title: 369-26 Veterinary Clinical Skills, Simulation and Immersive Learning Platform
results.why: High-value immersive-learning scope, but DCE is PQQ/reference driven and requires major insurance levels including EUR 13m employer, EUR 6.5m public/product and EUR 3m professional indemnity. Partner-heavy.

results.title: Germany – Erneuerung Citrix NetScaler WAF im SAP-Kontext
results.why: Vendor-specific Citrix hardware/licensing plus 60 months support. DCE requires three references including one university/public-sector reference, SAP-on-NetScaler experience, employee profiles and certification evidence. Reseller/integrator route only.

results.title: Ireland – Unit4 ERP Implementation, Hypercare And Application Support Services
results.why: EUR 200k ERP implementation/support. DCE explicitly encourages SMEs to form relationships with other SMEs/larger enterprises and requires migration, testing, cutover, API, training and knowledge-transfer deliverables. Strong partnerable opportunity with a Unit4 implementer.

results.title: RFP-HO-06-2026 – Brand Strategist
results.why: Actual DCE is a six-month SAHRC Brand Strategist engagement covering research/survey, brand strategy, repositioning, messaging and social-media monitoring/management. Excellent creative/AI-assisted scope, but bidder track record remains a gate.

results.title: Design, layout and printing of Department of Agriculture five-year report
results.why: Hidden gem: DCE explicitly asks for design, layout and printing of the five-year report. Directly brokerable with AI/design plus print subcontractor. Main friction is South African administration and apparent physical quotation-box submission in Pretoria.

results.title: AI Technologies for Procurement Modernization Commercial Solutions Opening
results.why: DHS CSO directly targets AI procurement modernization, including procurement news monitoring, sentiment, alerts and lifecycle visibility. Strategically excellent fit with the tender engine, but federal registration, cybersecurity and business-viability requirements are material.

results.title: Poland – Modernizacja systemów ochrony środowiska z API i udostępnieniem danych
results.why: Substantive modernization of multiple environmental systems with REST APIs, data publication, security/accessibility standards and buyer-provided VMware infrastructure. Strong software lane; local technical/reference partner prudent.

results.title: France – Impression des supports de communication de Beaucaire Terre d'Argence
results.why: Straight printing of communication supports. Strong middleman/print-broker lane with long runway, but compact gate extraction is insufficient to declare GREEN before volumes, samples/references and delivery requirements are checked.

results.title: Belgium – Supply chain traceability services and forced labour risk detection pilots
results.why: EUR 425k European Commission pilot is digitally aligned and geographically attractive. Domain expertise, data sources, pilot methodology and qualification thresholds need deeper verification before GREEN.

results.title: Predictive Lake Analytics Nextgen eXchange Services (PLANXS)
results.why: DCE is a justification for exception to fair opportunity / non-competitive extension of the current PLANXS award, not an open new SPM opportunity.

results.title: SENT/022/2026-27
results.why: False positive: DCE concerns a lighting project and scores prior related lighting projects via reference letters/completion certificates. It is not website development.

results.title: R/V Caretta Shipyard Repairs
results.why: False positive: authoritative DCE is shipyard repair work, not a web-portal project.

results.title: Iziko Museums display infrastructure fabrication and installation
results.why: False positive: DCE is fabrication and installation of exhibition display infrastructure in Cape Town rather than graphic design alone.

results.title: RFQ/021/2026/27
results.why: False positive: DCE is basic Mandarin language training, not brand identity, and requires proof through three client reference letters.

screening_note: All 160 queue entries were scope-screened. This file persists the materially resolved/high-value adjudications. Remaining low-ranked or opaque rows were not forced into a final verdict when mandatory evidence was insufficient or supplier-feasibility needs a separate broker check.
learning_signals: Semantic fit can be badly wrong when generic terms such as web, training or communications appear inside unrelated DCEs.
National eTenders lanes may resolve deadlines more reliably than stale TED notice metadata.
Print/design and campaign opportunities can be under-ranked by a software-heavy ontology.
Licensing opportunities remain partner/reseller-possible until channel authorization is proven.
